name: MICE & Communication
description: A Bangkok-based event and sports management company, founded in 2003, that organizes Thailand's own IAAF/World Athletics-labelled Bangsaen races (Bangsaen21, Bangsaen42) and runs international marathon tour packages.

certifications.evidence: Listed as "MICE & Communication" under Thailand on London Marathon Events' own official tour operators page.
